answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization focuses on generating fluent and concise text from the original input document ... We conduct experiments on the non-anonymized version of the CNN/Daily Mail dataset ...

answer_2.quote: To evaluate summarization performance, we use the ROUGE metrics (R-1, R-2 and R-L).

answer_4.quote: Three annotators are asked to rank each set of three summaries with respect to readability and non-redundancy ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank summaries based on readability (grammaticality and coherence) and non-redundancy (brevity).
